vibe: Premium, high-conversion 'Money Machine' for Indian Creators

typography.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-tight

surface_strategies.cards: bg-[#0A0305] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden hover:border-[#E11D48]/50 transition-colors duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-[#E11D48] hover:bg-[#BE123C] text-white font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(225,29,72,0.4)] transition-all hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(225,29,72,0.6)]
buttons.secondary: bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4 backdrop-blur-md transition-all

motion_interactions.marquee_speed: slow and smooth, using react-fast-marquee or tailwind keyframes
motion_interactions.reveal: Use framer-motion for staggered fade-in up on scroll

creators.use_case: Testimonial avatar or live stream mockups

lifestyle_wealth.use_case: Background or mood image for the Final CTA section, heavily darkened with overlay

icons.use_case: Hero section floating element or How it Works step 1

sections_and_components.name: 1. Hero Section
sections_and_components.strategy: Split layout. Left: Massive Unbounded headline. Right: A CSS-built interactive mockup (NOT A STATIC IMAGE).
sections_and_components.mockup_instructions: Build a dark glassmorphism card using Tailwind. Inside it, show 'Total Revenue' with a huge number like '₹4,50,000'. Add a green '↑ +24% this week'. Use Recharts to render a glowing crimson line chart. Add floating UI elements like 'New Subscriber: +₹999'.
sections_and_components.actions: Dual buttons: 'Start Free' (Primary Crimson) and 'Watch Demo' (Secondary Glass).

sections_and_components.name: 2. Social Proof
sections_and_components.strategy: Infinite horizontal marquee using react-fast-marquee or CSS keyframes.
sections_and_components.content: Mix of text '5000+ Creators Earning' and small glass cards showing real-time fake payouts (e.g., 'Rahul withdrew ₹1,20,000'). Use lucide-react icons for checkmarks and wallets.

sections_and_components.name: 3. Benefit Cards (Bento Grid)
cards: Card 1 (Col-span 2): 'Earn with Subscriptions'. Show a mini pricing tier UI.
Card 2 (Col-span 1): 'Automate Telegram Access'. Show a bot icon kicking out unpaid members.
Card 4 (Col-span 2): 'Run Paid Live Sessions'. Cinematic dark card with glowing red 'LIVE' badge.

sections_and_components.name: 4. Live Streaming Showcase
sections_and_components.strategy: Immersive section. Center-aligned text 'Go Live & Earn Instantly'.
sections_and_components.visuals: Build a vertical 'phone' mockup using a div with rounded-[3rem] and border-8 border-gray-900. Set the background to one of the Creator images. Overlay a glass UI with '🔴 LIVE', '👁 1.2k', and floating chat messages paying money ('Ankit sent ₹500!').

sections_and_components.name: 5. Pricing
sections_and_components.strategy: 3 standard columns. The middle column MUST pop out (scale-105, border-[#E11D48], inner glow).
sections_and_components.details: Use Unbounded for price numbers. Emphasize that they make money, so the tool pays for itself.

sections_and_components.name: 6. How It Works
sections_and_components.strategy: Minimalist 3 steps. Connect Telegram -> Create Plans -> Start Earning.
sections_and_components.visuals: Use massive background numbers (1, 2, 3) in text-white/5 font-bold.

sections_and_components.name: 7. Final CTA
sections_and_components.background: Use the lifestyle_wealth image with a 80% dark crimson/black gradient overlay so it feels expensive but text is perfectly readable.
sections_and_components.actions: Massive primary button with pinging animation.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards for everything. Build custom glassmorphic divs using the surface_strategies defined above.
CRITICAL: The hero section MUST feature a UI mockup built entirely out of HTML/Tailwind/Recharts. Do not use an image tag for the dashboard mockup.
CRITICAL: Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) as per the design guidelines.
CRITICAL: Use the 'Unbounded' font for ALL headings (h1, h2, h3). Ensure it is loaded via Google Fonts in the HTML/CSS.
CRITICAL: Do not use generic blue/teal colors. The only allowed colors are Crimson/Rose (#E11D48), Dark Cherry background, White text, and Green/Gold strictly for 'money' accents.
